name: Mr Pearce Montfort
source:
Pearce Montfort has been Amesbury’s closest friend for many years, the two being so since school days.

The two are similar in many ways: firstborn heir, rich, titled, good family name, well-mannered, independent.

But, in other ways, they are completely different. Which is probably why they get along quite so famously!

(Taken from [url=http://seraphinitegames.tumblr.com/post/152705802201/the-ladys-choice-amesbury-update-1]dev webpage[/url])
